kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
نتعالج (form VI)
# نَتَعَالَجُ (nataʕālaju) /na.ta.ʕaː.la.d͡ʒu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَعَالَجَ (taʕālaja)
# نَتَعَالَجَ (nataʕālaja) /na.ta.ʕaː.la.d͡ʒa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَعَالَجَ (taʕālaja)
# نَتَعَالَجْ (nataʕālaj) /na.ta.ʕaː.lad͡ʒ/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَعَالَجَ (taʕālaja)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
